coverage_notes.note: The source identifies the licensed material as software; no service, input/output, privacy, security, or fee obligations are stated in the target text.
The Noncommercial Purposes section does not define what counts as noncommercial; no additional test has been inferred.
Fair-use rights depend on law and are not defined by the license.
The statement that these terms imply no other licenses is recorded as a scope boundary, not as a prohibition on conduct or a grant of additional rights.
The supplied chunk contains the target text; no external incorporated document is needed to model the extracted clauses.

entertainment, hobby projects, amateur pursuits, or religious

rules.condition_explanation: personal_use_for_listed_purpose means personal research, experiment, testing, personal study, private entertainment, hobby projects, amateur pursuits, or religious observance. For research, experiment, and testing, the use must benefit public knowledge. no_anticipated_commercial_application means there is no anticipated commercial application.

rules.source_excerpt:

contributes to infringement of any patent, your patent license
for the software granted under these terms ends immediately. If

rules.condition_explanation: patent_license_terminated_by_patent_claim means either the licensee made the specified written patent claim, terminating the licensee's patent license, or the licensee's company made such a claim, terminating that license for work on behalf of the company. Company has the definition supplied in the license.
